import sympy as sp
A=sp.symbols('A')
expr=(sp.sin(A)+1/sp.sin(A))**2+(sp.cos(A)+1/sp.cos(A))**2
base=sp.tan(A)**2+1/sp.tan(A)**2
opts={'A':7,'B':1,'C':3,'D':5}

assert fit==['A']
